title: Basin Street-area clarinettists and the brass bands
summary: Dejan on clarinettists and Tio; Minor on the old brass bands Tuxedo and Imperial.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: The Airfax used to play with the banjo player when the Ram and Browns ran trombone over there. Yeah. I told you one day we get a chance to go to Basin Lewis and catch up with him. Oh, yeah. That's right. Yeah. We got a fine clarinet player over there, too, called Warren Bennett.
We got an old, old clarinet player over there. They call him Labatt. Oh, yeah. Old man Labatt.
That's right. Now, where are the bands over there?
Do they swing as much as the ones here? I mean, were they in the class with the ones here, or do you think they...

Well, I tell you, see, most of them bars from over there, they just come over here and play. You see, Tio lived over there a while, too. Yeah. And you think I had a thing to leave from Basin Lewis, but in the 20s he traveled with us all over the country. And he stayed here a good while. And also Warren Bennett also. And just stayed around here a long time. Yeah. I used to go around and play with him sometime. But they can play. They can play. No doubt about that. They can play. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Did you ever play anything else in brass bands besides the card? No, that's the only thing I've tried to play with the trumpet. Were you there seventh
the old Ninegrass bands when you were a boy and following them what they were like?

Well, all of them during that time, like I said, was good and some of the fellas are still living now. Some of them are still living because they had the Tuxedo Band and they had the Imperial Band. And Lamb Farris had the Imperial Band. Yeah, they were still around. Some of them same old fellas are still around. Like Jim Crowe, he's still around. He worked with some of them. Tats still young. Tats.

Yeah. And the Imperial Band and the officer and the officer also. Terry is still living. He's still living. Isn't he? I don't know. I know his son is. I know his son teach school somewhere around here. Yeah.
